title: Employee Role Management
removeConfirm: Remove role for {{name}}? They will lose access to this CC role.
deptMappingDesc: Employees are automatically assigned a CC role based on their HR department. Manage the department-to-role mappings below.
deptRemoveConfirm: Remove auto-mapping for '{{key}}'? Employees in this department will default to 'generic'.
deptUnmappedDesc: These departments exist in the HR system but have no CC role mapping. Click one to pre-fill the form.
pinBroadcastDesc: The CC employee login PIN rotates at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of every month. A systemd timer broadcasts the new PIN to the Customer Care WhatsApp group automatically; this button is the manual fallback / re-send.
pinBroadcastConfirm: Send the current month's staff PIN to the Customer Care WhatsApp group(s) for every active country?
registrarDesc: Login accounts for village committee members who register customers on tablets. Registrars can only create customers — no other CC access. Optionally bind an account to one site.
registrarDeactivateConfirm: Deactivate '{{name}}'? They will no longer be able to log in or register customers.
registrarCreated: Registrar account created. Share the username and password with the committee member.
